items.title: Special termination right due to price increase (§ 57 Abs. 1 TKG)
items.quote: dürfen Sie den Vertrag nach § 57 Abs. 1 TKG außerordentlich kündigen – ohne Kosten und ohne Frist, innerhalb von drei Monaten, nachdem Ihnen diese Mitteilung zugegangen ist.
items.computation: This is a private company letter, not an authority notice, so the statutory Bekanntgabefiktion for authorities does not formally apply and the actual date of receipt (Zugang) governs. The letter gives no separate posting date, so, as an estimate for ordinary German postal delivery, receipt is assumed 4 calendar days after the letter date (19.04.2027 + 4 = 23.04.2027, a Saturday). This is an assumption, not a legal fiction, and is flagged in warnings. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted; the 3-month period (§188 Abs. 2 BGB) ends on the day in the third following month bearing the same number as the day of receipt: 23.04.2027 + 3 months = 23.07.2027 (a Saturday). Since this falls on a Saturday, under §193 BGB the period ends on the next business day: Monday 26.07.2027. No public holiday (NRW or Sachsen) falls between 24.07.2027 and 26.07.2027, so only the Saturday causes the shift.
